events.cue: the bench by the window in Deborah's late mother's old house

fact.text: Deborah's mother, who passed away a few years ago, used to sit on the bench by the window of her old house every morning and night with a book.

meaning.text: Sitting there helps Deborah stay connected to her mother, gives her peace, and makes her feel her mother's comforting presence (reaffirmed in S29).

events.cue: the pendant/amulet from Deborah's late mother

fact.text: Deborah has a pendant/amulet that reminds her of her mother, and she brings it when she visits the spot by the water near her mother's old house.

meaning.text: It makes her feel her mother's love and stay close to her; holding it brings her comfort and reminds her of love and strength.

events.cue: the family album with her parents' 1993 wedding photo

fact.text: After her father's sudden death, Deborah looked at the family album, including her parents' wedding photo from 1993.

meaning.text: Looking back on great memories is comforting, and photos give her peace during difficult times.

events.cue: the thank-you letter from her yoga group members

fact.text: Deborah received a letter from her yoga group members thanking her for the positive influence she had on them.

meaning.text: Those moments remind her why she is so passionate about yoga.

events.cue: the bouquet her friend gave her when she was struggling

fact.text: Deborah's friend gave her the bouquet when she was struggling.

meaning.text: It gives her hope and courage, and looking at it fills her with warmth and appreciation.

events.cue: the spot by the water near her late mother's old house

fact.text: Deborah likes to come to a spot by the water near her mother's old house.

meaning.text: It is where she reflects on her mother's life and finds peace; being surrounded by nature helps.

events.cue: the roses and dahlias in the garden

fact.text: After losing a friend last week, Deborah has been spending time in the garden among roses and dahlias.

meaning.text: The roses and dahlias bring her peace and comfort while she grieves; the garden is calming and nostalgic.

events.cue: the last photo with her friend Karlie from their hike

fact.text: Deborah's last photo with her friend Karlie was taken last summer when they hiked together.

meaning.text: Every time she sees it, she cannot help but smile.

events.cue: the island of Bali, where she practiced yoga

fact.text: Deborah traveled to Bali last year and found it a gorgeous island great for yoga.

meaning.text: It gave her peace; the sound of the waves and fresh air are wonderful.

events.cue: the yoga class she started in her neighborhood

fact.text: Deborah started a yoga class in her neighborhood and hosted a class for her neighbors on Friday.

meaning.text: Teaching it is calming and sharing it brings her happiness; she has made friends and built community connections.

events.cue: art shows, which remind her of her late mother

fact.text: Deborah went to an art show with a friend, and her mother was interested in art and believed art could connect people emotionally.

meaning.text: Going to an art show feels like experiencing it together with her mother even though she is gone; it is hard but comforting.

events.cue: the special bench in the park near her house where she and her mom chatted

fact.text: Deborah goes to a special bench in the park near her house where she and her mom would chat about dreams and life.

meaning.text: It holds special memories; visiting brings a mix of nostalgia and longing, but also peace and gratitude for the time with her mom.

events.cue: flowers, which her late mother loved

fact.text: Deborah's mother really loved flowers and they made her happy; Deborah brought flowers to the bench.

meaning.text: Bringing flowers connects her to her mother, who appreciated the simple things, and she feels nostalgia and gratitude.

events.cue: the yoga retreat near her mother's place

fact.text: Deborah went to a yoga retreat near her mother's place last week.

meaning.text: It was life-changing; she connected with nature, got to know herself, and found life more meaningful.

events.cue: her cats Max and Luna

fact.text: Deborah has cats Luna, adopted from a shelter, and Max, her late mother's cat whom she took in after her mother passed away.

meaning.text: They bring lots of joy and peace to her home.

events.cue: the note from her late friend with the quote 'Let go of what no longer serves you'

fact.text: Deborah has a note from a friend who will never be able to support her; it says 'Let go of what no longer serves you.'

meaning.text: She misses him, and the quote reminds her to let go of what no longer serves her.

events.cue: the old photo of Deborah from when she first started doing yoga

fact.text: Deborah has an old photo from when she first started doing yoga; her mother was her biggest fan and often came to her classes.

meaning.text: Her mother was her biggest source of motivation.

events.cue: her late mother's old friends

fact.text: Deborah reconnected with her mother's old friends, reminisced, and looked through her mother's photos.

meaning.text: Hearing stories was emotional and a mix of happy and sad, but overall comforting; she appreciates her mother more.

events.cue: the beach where she got married and discovered surfing

fact.text: Deborah got married at a beach and discovered her love for surfing there.

meaning.text: That beach is super special to her and is always filled with joy and peace.

events.cue: the smell of her late mother's special dish

fact.text: Deborah's mother loved cooking and made amazing meals; Deborah can still remember the smell of her mother's special dish filling the house.

meaning.text: The smell brought the family together and reminds her of her mother's love and warmth.

events.cue: the pineapple birthday cakes her mother baked for her

fact.text: Deborah's mother baked pineapple birthday cakes for her when she was a kid.

meaning.text: It always made her feel special.

events.cue: her late mother's lullabies and soothing voice

fact.text: Deborah's mother used to sing lullabies to her in a soothing voice.

meaning.text: Music reminds her of her mother and those memories; she feels lucky to have them.

events.cue: the blossom tree near her home

fact.text: There is a blossom tree near Deborah's home that bloomed magically every spring.

meaning.text: Watching it bloom filled her with awe and made her appreciate the beauty of life and hope for growth.

events.cue: the sunset over the water in Bogota

events.cue: her mini retreat to assess where she was in life

events.cue: her partner, whom she met in an engineering class

meaning.text: She loves the ride, and teaming up on engineering projects feels great and has brought them closer.

meaning.text: She felt relieved when she found her; it showed how much she loves her and made her feel love and gratitude.

events.cue: the quote in her bullet journal

events.cue: her virtual conference presentation

meaning.text: It was rewarding to know her efforts were appreciated and confirmed she is on the right track.
